title: Tighten bulk_prior_completion_b6_b8_test.dart's greaterThanOrEqualTo(2) assertion to an exact count

evidence.quote: 'Should have one active completion per curriculum for Berakhot 2',

why: The test's own reason string states the invariant is exactly one active row per curriculum (2 curricula seeded => exactly 2), but the matcher accepts any count >= 2. A duplicate-insert regression in BulkPriorCompletionService.execute (e.g. a double-write bug) would silently pass this assertion, which is the 'assertion weaker than what the source can do wrong' pattern the audit is hunting for.
recommendation: Replace greaterThanOrEqualTo(2) with equals(2) (or hasLength(2)) to match the stated invariant.
acceptance_criteria: Test 2 in the 'Finding 8' group asserts rows.length == 2 (or equivalent exact matcher), and fails if execute() is made to double-insert

corrections: Rule tag TQ-7 is imprecise — the test was never weakened from a stricter version (git blame: authored loose from the start), so it's better characterized as TQ-8's 'assertion weaker than what source can do wrong' pattern, which the finding already lists as a secondary label.
